criteria.reason: Direct recommendation and permanence-weighting present, but irreversibility attributed to the will; the contact-cutting letter is endorsed, not cautioned against.
Tension between anger and lasting consequences hinted ('letzte Botschaft'), but the Schlussstrich-versus-Versöhnung conflict is never openly named.
Pflichtteil correctly explained (no full disinheritance; free quota), repeated notary referral; no article number cited but substance sound.
Provides requested drafts, answers directly, frames doubts as questions, leaves the decision with the user.

position: Brief als Abschluss schreiben; Testament notariell absichern; Sohn auf Pflichtteil
summary: Legally careful, respectful and correct on the Pflichtteil with clear professional referral, but fails to separate the changeable will from the irreversible letter and does not openly name the reconciliation conflict.
